data.one_liner: Generate an interactive HTML showcase to list and analyze Flutter project assets.
data.what_it_does: Asset Showcase scans a specified directory of your Flutter project and generates an HTML file that visually lists your assets. It provides a responsive UI featuring a search bar, filtering by file extensions, and sorting by name or size.
use_when: You want to visually browse and inspect the assets in your Flutter project directory
You need to quickly search or filter project assets using a web-based interface
You want to sort assets by size or name to analyze project storage usage
avoid_when: You need a runtime UI component integrated directly inside your Flutter mobile app
You are working on a project type that does not use local file assets
strengths: Generates an interactive HTML showcase with a sticky search bar
Supports filtering by file extensions and sorting by name or size
Easy to run directly from the command line using Dart
weaknesses: Generates an external HTML file rather than an in-app widget
data.setup_notes: Add asset_showcase as a dev dependency in your pubspec.yaml file and run dart pub get.
